question: If 2 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 485136785, what will be the difference between the digits which are second from the left and third from the right?
solution:
**Given: **

 If 2 is added to each odd digit and 2 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 485136785:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/022a4718fdd2f94dbb43a6b15a7dc0be96de2adef7c628dbcc429f57a8522cb7.png] 

Second from the left is 6 and third from the right is 9 = 9 - 6 = 3

 The difference between the digits which are second from the left and third from the right is **'3'**.
